user.title: Welcome to CYD Studio
user.description: CYD Studio adds a designer for touch displays (Cheap Yellow Display) to your sidebar. You design the dashboard, CYD Studio writes the ESPHome code.

esphome.title: ESPHome Device Builder
esphome.description:
ESPHome directory {path}: {status}

actions_not_allowed.title: Display "{device}" may not control Home Assistant

confirm.title: Allow actions for "{device}"
confirm.description:
The display of the CYD Studio project "{project}" sends its taps (switching lights, sliders, scenes) as Home Assistant actions. Home Assistant blocks them until the ESPHome device is allowed to perform actions.

Submit to enable "Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions" for {device}. You can change it later in the ESPHome device options.

abort.device_removed: The ESPHome device no longer exists.
